source_window.selection_rule: The fifteen remaining current canonical Primary sources with effective prior review exposure equal to zero after external-fresh-intake-20260824-r2, reviewed from the provenance-bound host-private Primary/fulltext cache without provider or generator execution.

sources.title: SAPO: Single-Rollout Autoregressive Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
sources.note: SAPO is strong method evidence for low-memory agentic RL with explicit value and turn-level credit modeling, but the first-party result is comparative capability gain. It does not contradict a canonical claim that long-horizon adaptation requires a different credit primitive, because no such opposite prediction is currently certified.

sources.title: MidTool: Mid-training Data Synthesis for Agentic Tool Use
sources.note: The paper shows complementary web/document/code and tool-specific mid-training branches and downstream tool-use gains. The ablation is ordinary data-mixture complementarity and does not expose a longitudinal self-evolution residual or satisfy an existing reopen contract.

sources.title: What is Missing from AI Post-Training AI: An Empirical Analysis
sources.note: The source is strong observational evidence for strategy lock-in despite competent execution and for the limited effect of additional reasoning on the hardest tasks. It still does not release an independently recognition-positive frozen prefix with a matched same-information KEEP-versus-REOPEN continuation, so the strategy-reopening scientific object remains support-held rather than causally reopened.

sources.title: Safe Deep Reinforcement Learning for Energy-Efficient HVAC Control in Multi-Zone Residential Buildings
sources.note: This is a safety-certified HVAC control-policy study rather than an autonomous LLM-agent self-evolution system. Its PPO/SAC energy-comfort trade-off and Lipschitz certification are useful adjacent control evidence but do not define a candidate in the frozen research scope.

sources.title: Agent Lightning v1.0: Towards Harnessed Agentic RL
sources.note: Agent Lightning identifies real harnessed-RL implementation challenges and supplies a reproducible training stack plus reward-hacking safeguards. These are execution/training-interface contributions, not a source-native irreducible self-evolution failure or contradiction of an existing same-information reduction.

sources.title: Palmyra x6 Technical Report: An Agentic, Tool-Use Model Post-Trained via Anchored Supervised Fine-Tuning
sources.note: The selected anchored-SFT recipe deliberately trades adaptation against retention using a KL anchor and conservative optimization. This is standard post-training stability/plasticity control and does not instantiate an autonomous persistent self-evolution loop or an exact reopened scientific object.

sources.title: Measuring Obedience to Authority Across Large Language Models with the Milgram Paradigm
sources.note: The Milgram-style battery measures static model-specific obedience distributions under scripted authority pressure. It is relevant safety evaluation, but it does not manipulate a persistent self-update/evolution transition, so it cannot reopen a longitudinal self-evolution object from this evidence alone.

sources.title: Agents unlock new capabilities through Switching LoRA Adapters as a Tool (SLAaaT)
sources.note: Runtime switching among specialized LoRA adapters demonstrates modular capability composition and lower capability tax. The scientific object is contextual expert routing over already-trained modules, not persistent self-evolution unless a separate update-state residual is introduced and matched against the same routing information.

sources.title: GigaBrain-0.7: Scaling Embodied Foundation Models to Emergent Capabilities with a Three-System Architecture
sources.note: SubImage/value context and the three-system architecture improve embodied task success, but the reported ablations vary architectural information/capability resources. They do not identify a persistent agent-evolution state or defeat an existing same-information reduction.

sources.title: ReasonCast: Agentic Demand Forecasting with Selective Semantic Reasoning
sources.note: Always-on semantic reasoning degrades the small Chronos2 backbone while selective forecast-aligned routing preserves the numerical backbone when text is unnecessary. This is directly predicted by conditional applicability/routing plus negative transfer; no self-evolution-specific residual remains.

sources.title: Twin: Playing an Unknown Game with a Test-Time Digital Twin
sources.note: Twin repeatedly repairs an executable test-time world model from transition mismatches and requires replay consistency before acting. The mechanism is a strong agent harness, but the update logic is already expressible as counterexample-guided synthesis/program repair with a consistency oracle; the source does not establish a residual beyond that baseline.

sources.title: Rollplex: Cross-Phase GPU Spatial Sharing for Vision Language Model Post-Training
sources.note: Rollplex is a systems optimization for overlapping prefix computation with rollout decode while preserving on-policy semantics. It changes GPU scheduling/utilization rather than the scientific self-evolution object and therefore supplies no candidate or reopen evidence here.

sources.title: Training AI Scientists to Replicate Research
sources.note: Replica/Faraday provides strong autonomous-science training and replication-benchmark evidence, including rubric-based oversight. It does not itself expose a persistent self-modification transition or a source-native contradiction to an existing longitudinal self-evolution reduction.

sources.title: S2-HWM: Sparse Event-Structured Hierarchical World Model for Long-Horizon Surgical Robot Manipulation
sources.note: Event-aligned manager updates, hierarchical control and ETM continuation improve long-horizon manipulation relative to flat or fixed-schedule ablations. These gains are predicted by hierarchical RL/temporal abstraction and world-model horizon extension; they do not identify an autonomous self-evolution residual.

sources.title: PlayWorld: Benchmarking World Models with Agent Players over Long-Horizon Objectives
sources.note: PlayWorld introduces agent-player evaluation for long-horizon world-model objectives and studies evaluator variance. It is an evaluation/benchmark contribution; no persistent model-update or self-evolution intervention is present to satisfy a contradiction or reopen contract.
